verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own marketing headline says founders can 'Open a Business Account In Minutes', which addresses the speed of the story. That is only a single headline claim, though, with no detail on what full onboarding involves (KYC/verification approval time, account activation, card issuance, moving existing banking over). Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding timeline including verification and approval, detail on what 'fully onboarded' covers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed claim.
